QuestInfo.name: Remnants of Memory
QuestInfo.0: What is the truth about Shammos? Why is he trapped in a place like this? You may be able to learn more if you help him regain his memory.
QuestInfo.1: To help Shammos regain his memory, bring #bShammos's Diary Pages 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9#k to him. You can obtain them from the #bHectors#k and #bWhite Fangs#k in El Nath.
QuestInfo.2: You recovered the diary for Shammos so that he could regain his memory.

0.0: People call me crazy. Bah, they're probably right. I've been bombarded with all these images lately: a house, a town, friends... Human friends. The memories seem full of happiness, but every time I try to concentrate, they slip away, and that drives me half-crazy.

yes.0: Great. Take a look at this. It's missing some important pages... Pages 5 through 9, to be specific. According to the guy who brought this to me, he found it amongst the #bHectors#k and #bWhite Fangs#k in the cold snow fields. They probably have the missing pages, too. Get them for me. Quickly. I don't know when I'll lose my mind and become a crazy Hoblin again...
yes.1: I'll send you where the monsters are.

no.0: Have you no sympathy? I hope you'll change your mind...

0.1: But I did get a lead on how to recover my past. Someone found this in El Nath. It's my diary. Says so plain as day, right on the cover. The insides are a bit messed up, though. Can you help?

1.0: Yes! These are the pages! It's a little late, but you've still been a great help. Thank you.
